name: brand_kit_list
description: Lean brand-kit catalog for agent reasoning. Returns paginated summaries with id, name, status, palette hexes. Use brand_kit_get for full detail and documents. Kits appear under Library in the UI but never in library_list — use this whenever the user names a kit or says brand guidelines/standards. To generate on-brand, pass a kit `id` as `images_generate` `brandKitId`; a kit only works with Magnific One. @see guides_get('brand-kit')
